Published: 🔧 Flutter iOS CI can now select the Xcode version from an optional version file in the repo
🐛 Swift Package Manager resolution now starts from a clean Pods tree to avoid an Xcode crash linked to stale restored caches
🐛 Hardened App Store What's New localisation after review: locale matching is now case-insensitive, and the length check follows Apple's UTF-16 counting
⚡ Raised the translation response size limit so all locales are returned in one batch instead of falling back to English
🔧 Made the localisation dependency install non-blocking so a failure there can't hold up a release
✅ Added tests for case-insensitive locale matching and for carrying only What's New without overwriting existing metadata
🚀 Added automatic translation of App Store What's New release notes into every non-English locale
🔧 English locales keep the notes verbatim, and any failed or unusable translation falls back to English with a warning so releases are never blocked
🔧 Enabled the localisation step in the App Store publish workflow
🐛 Merged a fix so Flutter iOS builds resolve SPM packages before building the IPA
🐛 Fixed an issue where an older app version blocked a new iOS release by replacing it
